title: 7 transaction + ledger ORM models
scope: 7 SQLAlchemy 2.x ORM models: InwardHeaderModel + InwardLineModel; SalesHeaderModel + SalesLineModel; AdjustmentHeaderModel + AdjustmentLineModel; StockLedgerModel. Headers inherit (Base, TimestampMixin) so created_at is TIMESTAMPTZ. Lines and stock_ledger inherit Base only (no created_at except stock_ledger).
